curved browser tabs

Illustration·by @Ryan__Stephen·2026-08-28·inspora page·original post

What it is

Curved browser tabs: a browser chrome concept where tabs wrap around a rounded corner of the window - the active tab slides along a curved rail (bending around the window's top-right corner) as the user switches between sites (Maps, NYT, Hawaiian Airlines, Airbnb).

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-20%
Browser window over a rainbow-gradient desktop; tabs (Airbnb, Hawaiian Airlines, NYT) follow a curved path that wraps the window corner; content = Google Maps; side tab strip visible along the right edge.
20-45%
Tab selection changes: the active pill glides along the curved rail (following the bend, not a straight line); content crossfades to NYT.
45-70%
Active tab continues around the corner; Hawaiian Airlines page loads; inactive tabs stack behind along the curve with diminishing scale.
70-100%
Cycles to Airbnb; tabs keep sliding along the rail; the motion is a smooth arc with spring settle.

Mechanics

trigger
tab click / switch
elements
curved tab rail (SVG path wrapping the window corner), tab pills, content viewport
properties
tab position along path (path offset), tab rotation tangential to curve, content crossfade
timing
tab travel 450ms spring; content fade 250ms
easing
spring (stiffness ~200, damping ~24)
loop
demo cycles tabs

Build prompt

Build a curved-tab browser chrome. Define the tab rail as an SVG path: straight along the top edge then bending 90deg around the window's top-right corner with a 40px radius, continuing down the side. Each tab is a pill positioned by getPointAtLength(offset_i) and rotated to the path tangent. Tabs are spaced 8px apart along the path measured in arc length. Active tab: pill expands (min-width 160px, shows title + close X), inactive collapse to 40px dots/favicons; switching animates every tab's path-offset with a spring (stiffness 200, damping 24) so they bunch and flow around the bend like beads. Content area crossfades + slight scale 0.98->1 (250ms). Overflow tabs stack down the side rail with 0.9 scale steps. New tab: pill pops in at the end of the rail (scale 0->1 spring) and everything re-flows along the curve.
